text: Security is an essential part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data as it travels between the user and the server. Authentication helps confirm that users are who they claim to be, usually through strong passwords or two-factor methods. Input validation is also important, because it checks the data users submit and blocks harmful content. Developers must understand common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, and follow best practices to prevent them. By taking security seriously from the start, developers can build safer applications and protect both user data and trust.
